name: How long does it take to replace a shingle roof?
description: Shingle roof replacement usually takes 2-5 days for an average residential roof, depending on size, complexity, and weather conditions.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to replace a shingle roof?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a shingle roof replacement project depends on the size and complexity of your roof, weather conditions, and the size of the crew. For an average-sized residential roof, the process typically takes between two to five days from start to finish. Larger or more complex roofs, or those requiring significant repairs to the underlying decking, may take longer. Inclement weather can also cause delays. A clear timeline will be provided after the initial assessment.
